CNN, 7 August 2026 — "Iranian-backed proxies targeted Saudi Arabia, widening conflict in Middle East":
- Months of fighting between Tehran and Washington spilled into the wider region over the past couple of days, as Iranian proxies launched fierce salvoes in Yemen — a major escalation.
- On Friday a Saudi official told CNN the kingdom was braced for "multiple coordinated attacks" by the Iran-backed Houthis and Iraqi militias.
- The Houthis launched a flurry of attacks that reportedly killed and wounded dozens near the Yemen–Saudi border, drawing condemnation from Jordanian, Bahraini and Kuwaiti authorities.
- US sources told CNN that the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs, Gen. Dan Caine, has privately made clear that the US needs to find an off-ramp from the war with Iran — because the military options on the table to escalate could backfire.
- Related CNN (6 Aug): "Saudi Arabia braces for attacks on ports and airports by Iraqi militias working with Iran-backed Houthis."
